I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28932 Country: India Title: Using goods made of leather of unknown animals, which could be haram or halal, is haram or halal? Question: using goods made of leather of unknown animals, which could be haram or halal, is haram or halal? Answer ID: 28932 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 134/134/M=1432) The skin of animals not allowed for consumption also becomes clean (tahir) if it is slaughtered according to shariah or by tanning and its external use is lawful. But the pigskin is exempted. Hence, you need not to have unnecessary doubts. Yes, if you are sure about any article by shariah research that it is made of pigskin, then its use is not lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
